blocks.text:
A CSS pseudo-element is a keyword that can be added to a selector, to style a
specific part of an element.

items: Style the first letter or first line, of an element
Insert content before or after an element
Style the markers of list items
Style the user-selected portion of an element
Style the viewbox behind a dialog box

blocks.text: Pseudo-elements are denoted by a double colon (::) followed by the pseudo-element name:
Text pseudo-elements style specific parts of text content:

items: ::first-line - Style the first line of text
::first-letter - Style the first letter of text

blocks.text: Content pseudo-elements insert or style generated content:
For a complete list of all CSS Pseudo-elements, visit our CSS Pseudo-elements Reference.
